_comment: Authoritative Hiligaynon phrasing per dataset symptom key.
transcripts and by ai_service/analyzer.py when translating them back, so every
phrase here is guaranteed to round-trip to its symptom key.
Replaces a substring fallback that produced body-part-only text ('dalunggan'
for fast_heart_rate, 'glaucoma' for coma) and collisions where several distinct
Covers all 131 dataset symptoms so no condition is described in English only.
Spelling and prefix variants live in hiligaynon_symptom_variants.json.
